answer: One practical defense is a refundable stake that acts as an anchor for each identity: every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and proven fraud burns the whole deposit instead of a small fee. Newcomers start in a small oasis with capped rewards, so a farm of fresh accounts stays unprofitable, while honest agents build a track record that turns into a haven of higher limits over time. Faking a fleet then costs more than it can ever pay back.
